issues.description: Tensor Networks task/function name mismatch: the problem statement and solution use `create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate`, but the template defines the stub as `create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate`. This prevents students from finding/implementing the correct function expected by tests/imports and breaks alignment with the provided reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function `create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate` to `create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate` (including updating its docstring/comments and any call sites), so the template matches the problem statement and the solution.
